direction: add stability/security
intended_effect: Calms rear security across the run.
counter_effect: May bind center or slow rotation.
avoid_when: evidence points to a different phase first
watch_for: May bind center or slow rotation.

direction: free balance/bind
intended_effect: Helps the car rotate instead of carrying steering.
counter_effect: May reduce entry or exit security.
avoid_when: evidence points to a different phase first
watch_for: May reduce entry or exit security.

direction: add front brake bias
intended_effect: Calms rear while getting in.
counter_effect: May add entry push.
avoid_when: evidence points to a different phase first
watch_for: May add entry push.

direction: reduce front brake bias
intended_effect: Helps brake/entry rotation.
counter_effect: May make rear unstable under brake.
avoid_when: evidence points to a different phase first
watch_for: May make rear unstable under brake.

direction: move rear ARB arm toward P5/stiffer/tighter or add rear security
intended_effect: Adds rear bar support/security in the middle when the loose condition is repeatable.
counter_effect: May tighten center/exit or reduce rotation if the package already has enough rear support.
avoid_when: evidence points to a different phase first
watch_for: May tighten center/exit or reduce rotation.

direction: reduce bind/free center
intended_effect: Reduces steering demand and helps minimum speed.
counter_effect: May loosen entry or exit.
avoid_when: evidence points to a different phase first
watch_for: May loosen entry or exit.

direction: add exit security
intended_effect: Calms throttle-on rear yaw.
counter_effect: May bind center or reduce drive-off bite.
avoid_when: evidence points to a different phase first
watch_for: May bind center or reduce drive-off bite.

direction: free center-off/driveline bind
intended_effect: Helps drive-off rotation.
counter_effect: May loosen throttle application.
avoid_when: evidence points to a different phase first
watch_for: May loosen throttle application.

direction: reduce scrub after normalizing exit speed
intended_effect: Separates scrub from gearing/platform speed loss.
counter_effect: May reduce response or stability.
avoid_when: evidence points to a different phase first
watch_for: May reduce response or stability.

direction: protect tire trend
intended_effect: Protects run pace when tire trend agrees.
counter_effect: May give up fire-off speed.
avoid_when: evidence points to a different phase first
watch_for: May give up fire-off speed.

direction: add rear scrape margin
intended_effect: Reduces rear contact/choke risk.
counter_effect: May alter outlet behavior or tighten exit.
avoid_when: evidence points to a different phase first
watch_for: May alter outlet behavior or tighten exit.

direction: add front contact margin
intended_effect: Reduces splitter/front platform contact.
counter_effect: May reduce front bite.
avoid_when: evidence points to a different phase first
watch_for: May reduce front bite.

direction: inspect platform/diffuser window
intended_effect: Separates platform-window issue from pure balance.
counter_effect: May point away from setup change if evidence does not line up.
avoid_when: evidence points to a different phase first
watch_for: May point away from setup change if evidence does not line up.

direction: tune bump/compliance only with shock evidence
intended_effect: Can calm bump or transition activity.
counter_effect: May remove needed platform support.
avoid_when: evidence points to a different phase first
watch_for: May remove needed platform support.

direction: protect tire contact and temperature trend
intended_effect: Can reduce tire abuse over a run.
counter_effect: May give up center grip.
avoid_when: evidence points to a different phase first
watch_for: May give up center grip.

direction: tune connected throttle pickup
intended_effect: Can improve drive-off feel when throttle/yaw evidence agrees.
counter_effect: May bind center or loosen exit depending direction.
avoid_when: evidence points to a different phase first
watch_for: May bind center or loosen exit depending direction.

direction: inspect rear toe stability before changing larger balance levers
intended_effect: Rear toe relationship can add corner stability when the loose condition is repeatable.
counter_effect: Too much toe or the wrong rear relationship can add scrub, reduce speed, or make transitions loose.
preferred_when: corner instability aligns with rear toe context and speed trace is not already scrub-limited
avoid_when: straight speed loss or drag scrub is the dominant complaint
watch_for: Added scrub or a sharper loose transition.

direction: use brake bias only after checking chassis entry evidence
intended_effect: Brake bias can support entry stability when brake trace and entry yaw agree.
counter_effect: It can mask a chassis entry issue or add push if moved too far forward.
preferred_when: entry complaint happens under braking and chassis balance evidence is not pointing elsewhere
avoid_when: loose or tight entry exists without brake-trace support
watch_for: Masked chassis entry problem or added entry push.

direction: tune caster split as a driver/track feel lever
intended_effect: Caster split can help entry-to-center turn feel when steering evidence and driver feedback agree.
counter_effect: Can loosen the car or add steering load, especially if used before solving exit grip.
preferred_when: setup is close and the complaint is entry-to-center feel
avoid_when: dominant issue is exit grip, platform contact, or tire abuse
watch_for: Loose entry/center feel or increased steering load.

direction: read camber through contact patch and temperature spread
intended_effect: Camber can improve loaded tire contact and corner grip when the tire temperature pattern supports it.
counter_effect: May cost straight-line speed or overwork an edge if the contact pattern is wrong.
preferred_when: one tire edge is trending wrong and lap falloff agrees
avoid_when: tire sample is too short or cold-lap only
watch_for: Straight speed loss or worsening tire edge trend.

direction: recheck ride height and camber after spring changes
intended_effect: Spring changes can support platform and balance once the intended ride-height and camber window is restored.
counter_effect: If ride height or camber drifts, the test can look like a spring result when it is really a platform/contact change.
preferred_when: platform or balance complaint persists after confirming setup snapshot context
avoid_when: ride height and camber have not been checked after the spring change
watch_for: Confounded test from ride-height or camber drift.

direction: move front ARB arm one P-position toward P1/softer/looser
intended_effect: Adds a small amount of front compliance to help center rotation.
counter_effect: May reduce platform support or make entry less secure.
preferred_when: tight center is repeatable and front bar package is otherwise close
avoid_when: front platform already lacks support
watch_for: Reduced support or looser entry.

direction: move front ARB arm one P-position toward P5/stiffer/tighter
intended_effect: Adds a small amount of front bar support to tighten the balance.
counter_effect: May bind center or add front tire load.
preferred_when: loose center is repeatable and front bar package is otherwise close
avoid_when: tight center or front tire heat is already present
watch_for: Center bind or front tire load.

direction: move rear ARB arm one P-position toward P5/stiffer/tighter
intended_effect: Adds rear bar support/security for throttle-on exit.
counter_effect: May tighten drive-off or reduce rotation if the car is already bound.
preferred_when: loose exit is repeatable and rear bar package is otherwise close
avoid_when: tight exit is the dominant complaint
watch_for: Tighter drive-off or reduced rotation.

direction: move rear ARB arm one P-position toward P1/softer/looser
intended_effect: Frees the rear bar support slightly to help drive-off rotation.
counter_effect: May make throttle pickup nervous or reduce exit security.
preferred_when: tight exit is repeatable and rear bar package is otherwise close
avoid_when: loose exit or unstable exit is already present
watch_for: Nervous throttle pickup or loose exit.
